flashcards.q: What are the two Qiskit primitives and their outputs?
flashcards.a: Sampler: shot-based bitstring counts. Estimator: expectation values of Pauli observables with precision bounds (requires measurement-free circuits).

flashcards.q: How do you read counts from a primitives V2 result?
flashcards.a: job.result()[0].data.meas.get_counts() for Sampler; job.result()[0].data.evs for Estimator; one PubResult per submitted PUB.
Primitive Unified Bloc: (circuit, observables, parameter_values) tuple; jobs accept lists of PUBs and return one result each, enabling parameter sweeps in a single submission.
execute(), qiskit.pulse, qobj, assembler, BackendV1, V1 primitives (Sampler/Estimator/BackendEstimator). Semver with yearly majors and 18-month support windows.
sigma = sqrt(p(1-p)/shots). At 1024 shots, p=0.5: sigma ~ 1.6%. Resolving p~1% needs >=10^4 shots (sigma ~ 0.1%).

flashcards.q: Four Aer simulation methods and when to use each?
flashcards.a: statevector (general, ~30-45 qubits), density_matrix (noise channels), stabilizer (Clifford-only, thousands of qubits), matrix_product_state (low entanglement, 100+).

flashcards.q: Memory for exact statevector at 45 and 50 qubits?
flashcards.a: 16 x 2^n bytes: 45q ~ 563 GB, 50q ~ 18 PB. Escape hatches: MPS for low entanglement, stabiliser for Clifford circuits.

Qiskit bitstrings are little-endian ('10' means q1=1,q0=0); Cirq measurement keys big-endian. Porting reverses multi-qubit outcomes; map indices explicitly and assert on asymmetric known-answer states.
Full pipeline: layout scoring, routing, basis translation, block resynthesis against a target backend; typically cuts two-qubit gate count 30-60% vs level 0. Seed it for reproducibility.
0 = raw; 1 = measurement-error mitigation + twirling (~2x shots); 2 = adds zero-noise extrapolation (~10x shots). Reduces bias while increasing variance and cost.

flashcards.q: Why use Sessions on IBM Runtime?
flashcards.a: Group related jobs to avoid re-queueing between them; amortises overhead for iterative workloads like variational loops; billed per second of QPU engagement.
Seed sampler/simulator/transpiler, pin SDK versions, record job IDs + backend calibration properties; hardware results are only statistically reproducible because calibrations drift.

flashcards.q: Cirq equivalent of sampling a Bell pair?
flashcards.a: cirq.Circuit(cirq.H(q0), cirq.CNOT(q0,q1), cirq.measure(q0,q1,key='m')); cirq.Simulator().run(circuit, repetitions=1000).histogram(key='m') gives {0:~500, 3:~500}.
